edbDesc: (or Stiction) Two solid objects pressing against each other (but not sliding) will require some threshold of force parallel to the surface of contact in order to overcome static cohesion. Static Friction is a threshold, not a continuous force.
title: Static Friction
pickWhy: A variant of friction (the grip before sliding starts); canonical 'friction' is in another batch. Note Coulomb's 1781 essay, which gave the deck's rolling-friction card, also covered static friction.
